title: LintDeckInput
description: Input to the lint_deck MCP tool.

deck_id.description: Identifier of the deck to lint.

deck_json.description: Optional deck content as JSON. If absent, the tool returns a single 'deck_not_loaded' info violation.

rules.description: Subset of rules to run. Empty = run all. Known rules: overflow, missing_alt_text, low_contrast, title_too_long, empty_slide, too_many_bullets.
